message.content:
The exchange rate between the U.S. dollar (USD) and the British pound (GBP) fluctuates constantly, so the exact amount will depend on the day you check. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2024), the conversion is roughly:

| USD | GBP |
|-----|-----|
| $1  | £0.78 |
| $20 | £15.60 |

So **$20 is approximately £15.60**.  

If you need the precise figure for a specific transaction, you can check a reliable financial news site, a bank’s currency converter, or a real‑time API such as the European Central Bank’s rates or a service like XE.com.
